resources.string: This profile is receiving an update. Try opening it shortly.
Use Save / Sync now below for native S3 signing or local files.

Automatic two-way sync uses the same shared file, space ID and password on both devices. Changes merge when only one side changed; concurrent edits become conflicts. Profile deletions do not propagate. Cookies require separate opt-in above; selected WebView profiles update known-site snapshots when backgrounded. Android jobs run at intervals of at least 15 minutes and may be delayed by battery or network constraints.
